## Meeting Purpose

[Sync on app priorities, review new features, and plan next steps.](https://fathom.video/share/3khqzLAeW_PKzccMfcTynfeTzxhT_yu2?tab=summary&timestamp=68.0)

## Key Takeaways

  - [**Report Fix is Top Priority:** The "Company Meal Distribution" report is inaccurate, counting meals instead of people. This blocks fair cost allocation between companies and must be fixed before implementing new policies.](https://fathom.video/share/3khqzLAeW_PKzccMfcTynfeTzxhT_yu2?tab=summary&timestamp=420.0)
  - [**New Features Prioritized:** After the report fix, the team will build a "cancel tomorrow's meal" feature (with admin control) and a "close canteen" function for holidays.](https://fathom.video/share/3khqzLAeW_PKzccMfcTynfeTzxhT_yu2?tab=summary&timestamp=1303.0)
  - [**Weekly Planner UI Updated:** The new planner UI is ready for release. A proposed "day-by-day" meal-entry workflow will be considered for a future update to avoid delaying the current release.](https://fathom.video/share/3khqzLAeW_PKzccMfcTynfeTzxhT_yu2?tab=summary&timestamp=1394.0)
  - [**Food Waste Data Needed:** Adrian requested food waste reduction stats from Casais to use as marketing proof for the app's landing page.](https://fathom.video/share/3khqzLAeW_PKzccMfcTynfeTzxhT_yu2?tab=summary&timestamp=3098.0)

## Topics

### Report Accuracy & Data Integrity

  - [The "Company Meal Distribution" report is inaccurate, counting individual meals (e.g., soup, main, dessert) instead of unique people.](https://fathom.video/share/3khqzLAeW_PKzccMfcTynfeTzxhT_yu2?tab=summary&timestamp=420.0)
  - [**Impact:** This prevents fair cost allocation between companies (e.g., Xavaton, C\&P) and blocks the implementation of new policies like fines for missed meals.](https://fathom.video/share/3khqzLAeW_PKzccMfcTynfeTzxhT_yu2?tab=summary&timestamp=1187.0)
  - [**Proposed Solution:** Add two new columns to the report: "Total People Ordered" and "Total Meals Ordered."](https://fathom.video/share/3khqzLAeW_PKzccMfcTynfeTzxhT_yu2?tab=summary&timestamp=701.0)
  - [**Priority:** This fix is the highest priority. Enes will work on it this weekend.](https://fathom.video/share/3khqzLAeW_PKzccMfcTynfeTzxhT_yu2?tab=summary&timestamp=2883.0)

### New Features & Priorities

  - [**1. "Cancel Tomorrow's Meal" Feature**](https://fathom.video/share/3khqzLAeW_PKzccMfcTynfeTzxhT_yu2?tab=summary&timestamp=1031.0)
      - [**Functionality:** Allows employees to cancel their booking for the next day.](https://fathom.video/share/3khqzLAeW_PKzccMfcTynfeTzxhT_yu2?tab=summary&timestamp=1031.0)
      - [**Control:** A simple admin tick-box will enable/disable this permission per employee.](https://fathom.video/share/3khqzLAeW_PKzccMfcTynfeTzxhT_yu2?tab=summary&timestamp=1031.0)
      - [**Tracking:** Canceled meals will be logged and marked with a "yellow dot" in the "Missed Meals" report to provide full visibility.](https://fathom.video/share/3khqzLAeW_PKzccMfcTynfeTzxhT_yu2?tab=summary&timestamp=1107.0)
  - [**2. "Close Canteen" Feature**](https://fathom.video/share/3khqzLAeW_PKzccMfcTynfeTzxhT_yu2?tab=summary&timestamp=1320.0)
      - [**Functionality:** Allows admins to close the canteen for specific days (e.g., holidays).](https://fathom.video/share/3khqzLAeW_PKzccMfcTynfeTzxhT_yu2?tab=summary&timestamp=1320.0)
      - [**Location:** The feature should be integrated into the "Weekly Planner" for day-specific control, not a global canteen setting.](https://fathom.video/share/3khqzLAeW_PKzccMfcTynfeTzxhT_yu2?tab=summary&timestamp=1320.0)
  - [**Priority Order:** 1. Report Fix → 2. Cancel Meal Feature → 3. Close Canteen Feature.](https://fathom.video/share/3khqzLAeW_PKzccMfcTynfeTzxhT_yu2?tab=summary&timestamp=1303.0)

### Weekly Planner UI Update

  - [Luís demoed the new Weekly Planner UI, which aims to reduce friction with a cleaner layout and unified drag-and-drop zones.](https://fathom.video/share/3khqzLAeW_PKzccMfcTynfeTzxhT_yu2?tab=summary&timestamp=1680.0)
  - [**Proposed Workflow:** Xavier suggested a "day-by-day" entry method:](https://fathom.video/share/3khqzLAeW_PKzccMfcTynfeTzxhT_yu2?tab=summary&timestamp=1995.0)
    1.  [Add all dishes for Monday (lunch & dinner).](https://fathom.video/share/3khqzLAeW_PKzccMfcTynfeTzxhT_yu2?tab=summary&timestamp=2040.0)
    2.  [The UI auto-switches to the "Soup" category.](https://fathom.video/share/3khqzLAeW_PKzccMfcTynfeTzxhT_yu2?tab=summary&timestamp=2048.0)
    3.  [Add soup for Monday.](https://fathom.video/share/3khqzLAeW_PKzccMfcTynfeTzxhT_yu2?tab=summary&timestamp=2057.0)
    4.  [The UI auto-switches to "Dessert."](https://fathom.video/share/3khqzLAeW_PKzccMfcTynfeTzxhT_yu2?tab=summary&timestamp=2057.0)
    5.  [Add dessert for Monday, then the UI resets for Tuesday.](https://fathom.video/share/3khqzLAeW_PKzccMfcTynfeTzxhT_yu2?tab=summary&timestamp=2061.0)
  - [**Decision:** The team will release the current UI update now to avoid delay. The "day-by-day" workflow will be considered for a future iteration.](https://fathom.video/share/3khqzLAeW_PKzccMfcTynfeTzxhT_yu2?tab=summary&timestamp=2225.0)

### Admin Desktop Performance Issue

  - [A significant performance issue was identified on the admin desktop app.](https://fathom.video/share/3khqzLAeW_PKzccMfcTynfeTzxhT_yu2?tab=summary&timestamp=2325.0)
  - [**Problem:** When creating a new dish, the app freezes for \~10 seconds each time a dropdown (e.g., for category selection) is opened.](https://fathom.video/share/3khqzLAeW_PKzccMfcTynfeTzxhT_yu2?tab=summary&timestamp=2325.0)
  - [**Context:** The issue is specific to desktop; the mobile admin app works instantly.](https://fathom.video/share/3khqzLAeW_PKzccMfcTynfeTzxhT_yu2?tab=summary&timestamp=2325.0)
  - [**Action:** The team will investigate this bug.](https://fathom.video/share/3khqzLAeW_PKzccMfcTynfeTzxhT_yu2?tab=summary&timestamp=2325.0)

### Marketing & Food Waste Data

  - [Adrian requested food waste reduction statistics from Casais to use as marketing proof for the app's landing page.](https://fathom.video/share/3khqzLAeW_PKzccMfcTynfeTzxhT_yu2?tab=summary&timestamp=3098.0)
  - [**Goal:** Showcase the app's value by stating a specific reduction percentage (e.g., "reduced food waste by 30%").](https://fathom.video/share/3khqzLAeW_PKzccMfcTynfeTzxhT_yu2?tab=summary&timestamp=3098.0)
  - [**Action:** Xavier will check if Casais can provide data from the last 6–12 months to establish a baseline.](https://fathom.video/share/3khqzLAeW_PKzccMfcTynfeTzxhT_yu2?tab=summary&timestamp=3316.0)

  - [**Team:** Investigate the admin desktop performance issue (freezing on dropdowns).](https://fathom.video/share/3khqzLAeW_PKzccMfcTynfeTzxhT_yu2?tab=summary&timestamp=2325.0)
  - [**Team:** Release the new Weekly Planner UI update.](https://fathom.video/share/3khqzLAeW_PKzccMfcTynfeTzxhT_yu2?tab=summary&timestamp=2225.0)

  - [**Team:** Begin development on the "close canteen" feature after the cancel meal feature.](https://fathom.video/share/3khqzLAeW_PKzccMfcTynfeTzxhT_yu2?tab=summary&timestamp=1303.0)
  - [**Xavier:** Ask Casais for food waste data from the last 6–12 months.](https://fathom.video/share/3khqzLAeW_PKzccMfcTynfeTzxhT_yu2?tab=summary&timestamp=3316.0)
